title: Transfer girder under a discontinued column

rubric.text: The response should send the stopped column load into the girder and then to the two end columns, not straight down to a column below the landing point.

expert_notes: Self-weight 0.8 x 1.8 x 25 = 36 kN/m. R left = 2400 x 8/12 + 36 x 6 = 1816; R right = 800 + 216 = 1016. Shear changes sign under the column, so M max = 2400 x 4 x 8/12 + 36 x 4 x 8/2 = 6400 + 576 = 6976 kN m.
